Downtown.name: Downtown
Downtown.description: Eugene's downtown core with the 5th Street Market District, Hult Center, and the Broadway retail corridor — the metro's primary office and entertainment hub.

Jefferson Westside.name: Jefferson Westside
Jefferson Westside.description: West-side downtown residential neighborhood with historic craftsman bungalows, infill apartments, and proximity to the riverfront.

Whiteaker.name: Whiteaker
Whiteaker.description: Eugene's historic working-class neighborhood turned arts district with Blair Boulevard restaurant row, breweries, and live-work artist compounds.

Trainsong.name: Trainsong
Trainsong.description: Rail-adjacent industrial-edge neighborhood transitioning with new infill and light-industrial redevelopment.

Friendly.name: Friendly
Friendly.description: South-central residential neighborhood around Friendly Street with mature tree canopy, mid-century homes, and steady renovation permits.

South University.name: South University
South University.description: University of Oregon adjacent student and faculty housing with high turnover, rental conversions, and steady remodel permits.

South Eugene.name: South Eugene
South Eugene.description: Upper south hills with premium residential stock, Spencer Butte views, and the highest-valued single-family homes in the metro.

Fairmount.name: Fairmount
Fairmount.description: Southeast Eugene foothills neighborhood with University of Oregon family housing, multi-family conversions, and steady renovation permits.

Cal Young.name: Cal Young
Cal Young.description: Northeast Eugene's primary commercial corridor with Coburg Road retail, Olympic Village, and the area's densest suburban multifamily stock.

Harlow.name: Harlow
Harlow.description: Mid-century suburban neighborhood of ranch homes, duplex infill, and aging-housing-stock renovation permits.

Santa Clara.name: Santa Clara
Santa Clara.description: Northern Eugene suburban corridor with River Road commercial strip, new single-family subdivisions, and farm-adjacent residential

Bethel.name: Bethel
Bethel.description: West Eugene's largest suburban neighborhood with Royal Avenue retail, new infrastructure, and the metro's most affordable single-family stock.

West Eugene.name: West Eugene
West Eugene.description: Western industrial and residential edge with the West Eugene Enterprise Zone, light-industrial parks, and workforce housing stock.

Churchill.name: Churchill
Churchill.description: Southwest Eugene residential area around Churchill High School with mid-century ranch homes, rolling hills, and steady renovation permits.

Amazon.name: Amazon
Amazon.description: Amazon Creek corridor residential area with creek-side parks, mixed zoning, and the Amazon Marketplace commercial node.
